relation: Same 1908 photo. The published JPEG is a resized rendition of the TIFF.
notes: Qualla publishes a 1920 px JPEG rendition of W. E. Perroux’s 1908 photograph. I inspected it alongside the native TIFF and matched framing, image features, library citation, date and PD-Australia release. The photograph shows the original two-storey gabled hall, exposed studs, upper window rhythm and a small entrance projection.
